requests.name: community_exterior_paintover
requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: implementable art-direction paintover of a real Japanese anime village game screenshot. Image 1 is the edit target. Keep the exact camera, building shape and dimensions, doors, pavement, surrounding buildings, actual display openings, residents and their positions. Keep the sunny Japanese TV anime style, clean linework, flat cel colours and crisp light/shade, luminous blue summer sky and lavender shadows. Improve detailed construction, quiet material variation and signs of daily use, without photorealism, heavy painting, bloom, UI or captions. Keep all entrances, stairs and accessible ramps physically open. Do not invent a new storefront or cover transparent display glass. Enhance the community centre porch: richer aged cedar with visible straight joinery and pegs, clean pale plaster, blue-grey ceramic roof tiles, gently worn stone stair edges. Keep the existing engraved main sign and two warm paper lanterns. Make the existing right-hand notice board read as a real timber-framed glazed community board with a small sloped rain hood, a few cream paper notices and simple lantern/festival illustrations. Add a coherent low grouping of two modest ceramic planters and leafy summer plants at the porch side, clear of steps and ramp. An indigo cloth accent and a discreet wooden umbrella holder may sit beside the wall, with believable contact shadows. Calm maintained public building, not abandoned, not overdecorated.
